bites.title: Things that move
bites.body: The strip at the bottom is the Timeline. Animation is just keyframes: you say where something is at certain frames, and Blender fills in between.

bites.title: First keyframe
bites.body: Hover the viewport and press I, then pick Location. A diamond appears on frame 1 in the Timeline.
bites.hint: I is for Insert keyframe. The cube must be selected.

bites.title: Jump ahead
bites.body: Click frame 40 in the Timeline (or type 40 in the current frame box at the right).

bites.title: Second keyframe
bites.body: G, X, move the cube, click. Then I, Location again.

bites.title: Roll film
bites.body: Hover the viewport and press Space to play. Press Space again to stop.
bites.hint: Space toggles playback. Esc stops and jumps back.

bites.title: Scrub
bites.body: Drag the blue playhead back and forth along the Timeline. That's scrubbing: you control time by hand.

bites.title: Add a spin
bites.body: Go to frame 80. Press R, Z, 180, Enter, then I and pick Rotation.
bites.hint: Frame 80 first, then rotate, then I, Rotation.

bites.title: Watch your film
bites.body: Press Home over the Timeline to see the whole range, set End to 80, and press Space. Slide, spin, done.

bites.title: Lesson 13: cleared
bites.body:
Keyframes, the Timeline, playback, scrubbing, and animating rotation. Things move when you say so.
